question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Fatal
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fatal"** means something that causes death or leads to a very serious outcome. (घातक)

 
 
• **Example: **The accident proved to be **fatal **for the driver.
 
 
 
• **"Deadly" **refers to something that is capable of causing death or is extremely dangerous. (मृत्युदायक)
 
 
• **Example: **The venom of some snakes is **deadly** to humans.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'fatal' **is **'deadly'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Additional **(अतिरिक्त): Something that is extra or added to what is already present.

 
 
• **Example:** We need additional resources to complete this project.
 
 
 
• **Jovial **(प्रसन्न): Cheerful and friendly.
 
 
• **Example: **He was in a jovial mood at the party.
 
 
 
• **Easy** (आसान): Something that is not difficult and requires minimal effort.
 
 
• **Example:** The exam was surprisingly easy for most students.
 
 

32:Tc9f,

The correct answer is: Option 2.</
